title: Service Contracts: Minimum Quantity Commitment Shortfall and Dead Freight
content:
Every AHL Service Contract binds the customer to a minimum quantity commitment in FEU. When the volume lifted falls below it, the line assesses dead freight. This calculation guide defines the periods assessed, how the shortfall is measured, the tolerance, the rate per FEU and the smallest assessment that is booked.

## Assessment bases

**Term end.** The whole term is assessed a single time, after the contract has expired or been terminated. The commitment assessed is the full minimum quantity commitment. The shortfall is the amount by which the volume lifted over the term falls below that commitment, and it is zero when the lifting meets or passes the commitment.

**Quarterly prorated, with a term-end true-up.** Each contract quarter is assessed separately against one quarter of the minimum quantity commitment, called here the quarterly commitment. Any lifting of the preceding quarter beyond its quarterly commitment is carried into the next quarter's assessment, but no more than the tier's carryover percentage of the quarterly commitment may be carried. When the term ends a true-up is assessed: its shortfall is the shortfall of the whole term, reduced by the FEU of shortfall already charged in the quarterly assessments, and it never goes below zero.

## Tolerance, rate and minimum

- If the shortfall of an assessment is no larger than the tier's tolerance percentage of the commitment that assessment covers, nothing is charged.
- If it is larger, the charged FEU are the full shortfall of that assessment, and the dead freight equals the charged FEU multiplied by the tier's rate per FEU.
- An assessment whose dead freight comes to less than the tier's minimum amount is not booked.

## Other conditions

A shortfall can be assessed only on a contract whose status is active, suspended, expired or terminated. A given period of a contract, whether a quarter or the term, is assessed no more than once. Dead freight assessed forms the contract's shortfall balance, which the customer owes until it is paid or waived.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Assessment basis | Tolerance (percent of commitment assessed) | Dead freight (USD per FEU) | Carryover cap (percent of quarterly commitment) | Smallest assessment booked (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | term end | 0 | 450 | 0 | 100 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | term end | 5 | 400 | 0 | 100 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | term end | 5 | 350 | 0 | 250 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | quarterly prorated with true-up | 10 | 300 | 20 | 250 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | quarterly prorated with true-up | 10 | 250 | 25 | 500 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | quarterly prorated with true-up | 15 | 200 | 30 | 500 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts)

**Standard, term end, commitment 200 FEU.** The tolerance is 10 FEU (5 percent of 200).
- Lifted 185 FEU: shortfall 15 FEU, above the tolerance, so all 15 FEU are charged at 400 USD, giving 6000 USD, which is above the 100 USD minimum and is booked.
- Lifted 192 FEU: shortfall 8 FEU, within the tolerance; nothing is charged.
- Lifted 190 FEU: shortfall exactly 10 FEU, equal to the tolerance; nothing is charged.

**Starter, term end, commitment 50 FEU, lifted 49.9 FEU.** With no tolerance, the 0.1 FEU shortfall is charged at 450 USD, giving 45 USD. That is below the 100 USD minimum, so no assessment is booked.

**Key Account, quarterly, commitment 1000 FEU.** Quarterly commitment 250 FEU; quarterly tolerance 25 FEU; at most 50 FEU (20 percent of 250) can be carried.
- Quarter 1 lifts 320 FEU: 70 FEU beyond the quarterly commitment, of which 50 FEU is carried.
- Quarter 2 lifts 180 FEU; with the 50 FEU carried it reaches 230 FEU, a shortfall of 20 FEU, within tolerance: nothing charged.
- Quarter 3 lifts 210 FEU and nothing is carried in: shortfall 40 FEU, beyond tolerance, charged in full at 300 USD, giving 12000 USD.
- Quarter 4 lifts 230 FEU: shortfall 20 FEU, within tolerance.
- True-up: the term lifted 940 FEU, a term shortfall of 60 FEU; less the 40 FEU already charged leaves 20 FEU, inside the 100 FEU tolerance on the 1000 FEU term commitment, so nothing further is charged.
